links.comparator_used: Original interpretive results (routine manual cytology review of all cases), used as the reference standard
links.outcome: Accuracy of AI-designated negative cases (NPV and sensitivity) and anticipated workload reduction when cases within the 50% negative cutoff skip further review
links.effect: 98.80% of AI cases designated as not needing further review were negative on original diagnosis. For ASC-H or higher, sensitivity was 90.77% and NPV 98.80%. For LSIL or higher, sensitivity was 98.92% and NPV 99.94%.
links.tradeoff: 49 LSIL+ cases were designated by AICyte as not needing further review. Of these, histology showed 8 CIN1 and 18 negative, and the rest had no histologic follow-up. Sensitivity for ASC-H+ was 90.77%, so some abnormal cases would be missed. Workload reduction was anticipated, not measured.
links.quote: In 98.80% of all artificial intelligence cases that were designated as not needing further review, the corresponding original diagnosis was also determined to be negative.

design_hint: AI triage with 50% negative cutoff threshold selection
